name: mcp-linker-skills
description: Curated and community agent skills for MCP Linker's Skills page.

skills.name: ios-signing-troubleshooting
skills.description: Diagnose iOS code signing, provisioning profile, entitlement and certificate errors from Xcode or xcodebuild. Use when a build, archive or export fails with signing errors, "No profiles found", "Provisioning profile doesn't include", or keychain problems.

skills.name: ios-simulator-build-run
skills.description: Build an iOS app and run it on the Simulator, then read build errors, logs and screenshots. Use when asked to build, run, launch, test or debug an iOS/iPadOS app, or when xcodebuild fails.

skills.name: ios-simulator-ui-automation
skills.description: Drive a booted iOS Simulator like a user with the axe CLI (describe-ui, tap, swipe, type, screenshot, record-video) to verify UI flows, reproduce bugs and capture screenshots. Use when asked to tap, scroll, type into, screenshot or smoke-test a running iOS app.

skills.name: ios-testflight-release
skills.description: Archive an iOS app, upload it to TestFlight and submit it to the App Store using the asc (App Store Connect) CLI, with a pre-release checklist. Use when asked to ship, release, upload a build, distribute a beta, or submit to App Review.

skills.name: macos-build-test
skills.description: Build, run and test macOS apps and Swift packages from the command line with XcodeBuildMCP, xcodebuild and swift. Use when asked to build, launch, test or debug a macOS target, a Swift package, or a menu bar, AppKit or SwiftUI Mac app.

skills.name: macos-notarize-distribute
skills.description: Sign with Developer ID, notarize with Apple, staple and package a macOS app as a DMG or ZIP for distribution outside the Mac App Store, using codesign and the asc CLI. Use when asked to notarize, staple, or ship a Mac app directly.

skills.name: pdf
skills.description: Read, merge, split, fill, watermark and OCR PDF files, or create new ones.

skills.name: docx
skills.description: Create, read and edit Word documents, including tracked changes, comments and templates.

skills.name: pptx
skills.description: Create and edit PowerPoint decks: layouts, templates, speaker notes and comments.

skills.name: xlsx
skills.description: Open, clean, compute on and create spreadsheets (xlsx, csv, tsv) with formulas and charts.

skills.name: doc-coauthoring
skills.description: A structured workflow for co-authoring docs, proposals, specs and decision records.

skills.name: frontend-design
skills.description: Distinctive, intentional UI design: aesthetic direction and typography that avoid templated defaults.

skills.name: canvas-design
skills.description: Create posters and static visual art as PNG or PDF from a design philosophy.

skills.name: algorithmic-art
skills.description: Generative art with p5.js: seeded randomness, flow fields and interactive parameters.

skills.name: theme-factory
skills.description: Apply one of 10 preset themes (colors and fonts) to slides, docs and HTML pages, or generate a new one.

skills.name: slack-gif-creator
skills.description: Make animated GIFs sized and validated for Slack.

skills.name: web-artifacts-builder
skills.description: Build multi-component HTML artifacts with React, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui.

skills.name: webapp-testing
skills.description: Test local web apps with Playwright: check UI behavior, capture screenshots and read browser logs.

skills.name: mcp-builder
skills.description: Guide for building well-designed MCP servers in Python (FastMCP) or TypeScript.

skills.name: claude-api
skills.description: Claude API and Anthropic SDK reference: models, streaming, tool use, caching and migration.

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.description: Create, improve and benchmark skills, and tune their descriptions to trigger reliably.

skills.name: brainstorming
skills.description: Turn a rough idea into a design through questions before any code is written.

skills.name: writing-plans
skills.description: Write a step-by-step implementation plan from a spec before touching code.

skills.name: executing-plans
skills.description: Carry out a written plan in batches with review checkpoints.

skills.name: subagent-driven-development
skills.description: Execute a plan by dispatching a fresh subagent per task with review between tasks.

skills.name: dispatching-parallel-agents
skills.description: Split independent problems across parallel agents.

skills.name: test-driven-development
skills.description: Write the failing test first, then the code that makes it pass.

skills.name: systematic-debugging
skills.description: Find the root cause of a bug before proposing a fix.

skills.name: verification-before-completion
skills.description: Run the checks and confirm the evidence before claiming work is done.

skills.name: requesting-code-review
skills.description: Request a review of finished work against the plan before merging.

skills.name: receiving-code-review
skills.description: Handle review feedback with technical rigor instead of blind agreement.

skills.name: using-git-worktrees
skills.description: Work on a feature in an isolated git worktree.

skills.name: finishing-a-development-branch
skills.description: Decide how to land finished work: merge, PR or cleanup.
